column1: # Pinned manifest for the bundled spelling dictionaries.
# bundle-dictionaries.ps1 fetches every row below from ONE upstream tree --
# the LibreOffice `dictionaries` repository -- at the commit pinned in the
# script, and writes resources/dictionaries/<tag>/. Raw URLs at a commit SHA
# are immutable, so the pin plus the per-file sha256 in this file is the
# integrity record; nothing is re-fetched at build time from a moving ref.
#  aff     the Hunspell affix table, written as <tag>.aff
#  dic     the Hunspell word list, written as <tag>.dic
#  notice  an upstream licence or readme file, copied verbatim into
#  - A dictionary is never dropped to simplify this file. Copyleft rows are
#    ordinary rows: this project is MIT open source with a public repository,
#    so the source column answers "where is the source".
#  - Every tag carrying an aff+dic pair must carry at least one notice row.
#    bundle-dictionaries.ps1 refuses to write the tree otherwise.
#  - A tag ships only once its smoke set passes (tests/test_spelling.py):
#    ordinary words of the language must be accepted and planted misspellings
#    rejected. A dictionary that rejects its own vocabulary is worse than no
#    dictionary, so it does not get a row here.
#  - Keep sorted by tag, then role, so a diff reads cleanly.
